title: AI-assisted proof of optimal packing for 11 squares
summary: This project uses AI-assisted formal verification methods to prove the optimal packing configuration of 11 equal squares within a containing square, addressing the classic 'packing squares in a square' mathematical optimization problem.
problem_solved: Determines the minimum-size containing square that can optimally pack 11 equal smaller squares using formal mathematical proof.
why_valuable: Demonstrates AI's growing role in advancing mathematical research by providing rigorous formal proofs for geometric optimization problems that were previously verified only through computational methods.
